headline: Set public hearing for June 1, 2026, on naming road into Beverly Golf & Tennis "Matzeliger Way."
summary: The City Council took up Order #061, a request to start the process of naming the road into Beverly Golf & Tennis as "Matzeliger Way" in honor of Jan Ernst Matzeliger. The council voted to schedule a public hearing on the matter for June 1, 2026, at 7:30 PM.
decisions: Set a public hearing for June 1, 2026, at 7:30 PM on naming the road into Beverly Golf & Tennis as "Matzeliger Way," as recommended by the subcommittee; motion carried 7-0.
